title: Herencias coloniales
goal: Read why the castas were abolished within years of independence, yet the inequality they described kept showing up statistically for generations afterward.

items: Explain what happened to the legal caste system when independence broke out.
Explain what did NOT disappear at the same time as the legal categories.
Describe the long-term statistical pattern the text points to.
Explain why this continuity doesn't mean legal independence was unimportant.
Use passive voice to distinguish fast legal change from slower social change.
